field.label: Enabled
field.comment: Flush the full page cache after changing these settings.

field.label: Prioritise the LCP image
field.comment: Preloads the PDP main photo, the first listing image or the first CMS image with fetchpriority="high".

field.label: Product images loaded eagerly on listings
field.comment: Luma lazy-loads every listing image, including the first row on screen.

field.label: Lazy-load CMS images further down the page
CMS images loaded eagerly
field.comment: The first image is the prioritised hero; this many images in total are never lazy-loaded, because on phones the promo tiles under the hero are usually on screen.

field.label: Responsive WebP for CMS images
field.comment: Creates WebP copies at the widths below in pub/media/softcode/rsz and adds srcset, so phones don't download full-size banners. Needs PHP GD with WebP.

field.label: WebP widths
field.comment: Comma-separated pixel widths. Widths above the original are skipped.

field.label: Add missing image width/height
field.comment: Read from the image file (pub/media, pub/static; SVG via width/height or viewBox), so the browser reserves space before the image loads.

field.label: Load these stylesheets without blocking render
field.comment: One path fragment per line, e.g. mage/calendar. (only needed by date pickers; matches the .min.css too).

field.label: Inline these stylesheets
field.comment: One path fragment per line. Their contents go into the page as a style element, removing a render-blocking request; relative url()s are rewritten. Each page gets bigger by the stylesheet's size, so keep this to what every page needs first.

field.label: Inline used CSS per page type
field.comment: Inlines only the CSS rules each page type uses and loads the full stylesheets without blocking. Needs used-CSS files built for the deployed theme (usedcss/ in its static folder); rebuild after every static content deploy. Without them nothing changes.

field.label: Extra inline CSS
field.comment: Small corrections added to the head without an extra request.

field.label: Use RequireJS bundles
field.comment: Loads Luma's modules from a few per-page-type bundles instead of 200+ separate files. Needs bundles built for the deployed theme (bundle/manifest.json in its static folder); rebuild after every static content deploy. Without them nothing changes.

group.label: Third-party scripts
group.comment: Measured on Luma, third-party scripts (tag manager, analytics, consent, chat) caused most of the mobile total blocking time. Scripts whose src, or whose inline code, contains one of these fragments stay inert until allowed; Magento's own scripts are never touched. One fragment per line, e.g. googletagmanager.com, connect.facebook.net, widget.intercom.io.

field.label: Load only after consent
field.comment: Tracking and marketing scripts. Under GDPR these may not run before consent anyway.

field.label: Load on first interaction
field.comment: Widgets not needed before the visitor scrolls, taps, types or moves the mouse (chat, reviews, social embeds).

field.label: Consent comes from
field.comment: Generic: your consent banner calls window.softcodeConsentGranted() (or dispatches the window event softcode:consent-granted) when the visitor accepts; it is remembered for later pages.

field.label: Fix top menu ARIA roles
field.comment: Adds role="none" to the menu's list items, which jQuery UI leaves between role="menu" and role="menuitem".

field.label: Fonts to keep preloading
field.comment: One file name per line. Other fonts still load, just not ahead of the LCP image.
